subject: general
question: Who is the author of the Panchatantra collection of fables?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishnu Sharma.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Vishnu Sharma**

__
 
• Indian scholar and author.
 
• His **notable works **include** the Panchatantra collection of fables.**

**Panchatantra**

 
• There are** 84 stories and also many interpolated fables in it. **
 
• The first book in the Panchatantra is** Loss of Friends (Mitrabhed) and it contains 34 stories.**
 
• **Five Tantras were: **Mitra Bhedha(Loss of Friends), Mitra Laabha(Gaining Friends), Suhrudbheda(Causing discord between Friends), Vigraha(Separation), and Sandhi(Union).

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__****Skandagupta​**

 
• Gupta emperor of India.
 
• He** ascended the throne** in the year **136 of the Gupta era.**
 
• **Bhitari pillar inscription** suggests that he **restored the Gupta power by defeating his enemies.**
 
• He repulsed an invasion by the** Indo-Hephthalites (Hunas in India), **probably the** Kidarites.**

**Vishnu Gupta **

 
• One of the lesser know kings of** Gupta Dynasty.**
 
• He was the** son of Kumaragupta III** and the **grandson of Narasimhagupta.**
